name: doodle
description: A local-first two-way board where people and AI draw to express intent, packaged as a desktop-only Codex plugin and MCP server.

interface.longDescription: Doodle is a local-first two-way board. A person and an AI both draw notes, text, shapes, arrows, freehand ink, images, and connected visual compositions on one canvas to express intent; either side can read and continue what the other drew. Four focused MCP tools work in every host; MCP Apps rendering, final-state context sync, notification, and an editable board library are local capabilities. Conversation stays in the host chat. Project structure is only one possible subject, and the board never writes project files.
defaultPrompt: 打开 Doodle 画板，我们先用画板交流。
